_about: GB300 NVL72 是否在 2025-06-30 前实际交付的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-04-30；原两条后截点资料已替换为 2025-03-18 官方发布。

evidence.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra AI Factory Platform Paves Way for Age of AI Reasoning
evidence.excerpt: Blackwell Ultra-based products are expected to be available from partners starting from the second half of 2025.
evidence.claim: NVIDIA 在截点前明确把合作伙伴 Blackwell Ultra 产品可用时间指向 2025 年下半年，不支持 6 月底前已交付。

evidence.title: Supermicro Adds Portfolio for Next Wave of AI with NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra Solutions
evidence.excerpt: Supermicro is announcing new systems and rack solutions powered by NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra platform.
evidence.claim: Supermicro 在 GTC 2025 宣布 GB300 NVL72 方案，属于发布/产品规划信息，而非已完成客户交付的证明。
